entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Representative.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to start a return for an order I received a couple of weeks ago. It's for two items.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-789012.
Great, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It's for a Pro-Series jersey and a VeloBand Pulse, delivered 14 days ago. Is that correct?
That's the one. The jersey doesn't fit quite right and the Pulse just isn't what I was looking for.
I understand. Let's get this sorted out for you. I can definitely process the return for the jersey; it's well within our 90-day return period for apparel.
Regarding the VeloBand Pulse, however, I see that we are outside of its specific return window. That item has a 10-day return policy.
Wait, what? I bought them in the same order. That makes no sense. Why would there be separate policies for items bought together?

I can see why that would be confusing. Because the VeloBand Pulse is a health and electronics device, its return policy is more strict than our standard apparel. Our system shows it was delivered 14 days ago, which is four days past the window for that specific item.
This is ridiculous. I paid for the VeloGuard Warranty. Doesn't that cover returns? I want to return both items, not just one.

That's a great question. The VeloGuard Warranty is an excellent plan that covers any manufacturing defects or malfunctions, but it doesn't extend the standard return window for items that are not defective.
I can't believe this. I've been a VeloFit customer for years. This is how you treat people? This is completely unacceptable.

I truly understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the confusion. While I am bound by the policy on the refund for the Pulse, I do want to make this right for you. How about this: I'll process the full refund for the jersey right now, and for the inconvenience and the mix-up with the policy, I can add a $25 store credit to your VeloFit account.
So... I get the money back for the jersey and a $25 credit? On top of that?
That's correct. The refund for the jersey will go back to your original payment method once we receive it, and the $25 credit will be available in your account immediately for your next purchase.
Okay... I guess that's fair. I'm still not happy about the policy, but I appreciate you offering a solution. That works for me.

Excellent. I'm glad we could find a resolution. I have just initiated the return for the jersey. The shipping label is on its way to your email inbox. I've also applied that $25 credit to your account. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's it. You've been very helpful, thank you for sorting this out.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we hope you have a wonderful day.
